subject: general
question: Chikkamagaluru in Karnataka is famous for the cultivation of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**coffee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bababudan Giri range (Chandra Drona Giri) of **Chikkamagaluru **is famous for its Coffee plantation.
 
• It is said that the 16th Century Sufi Saint Baba Budan was returning from Hajj.
 
• brought back the raw beans of coffee from Mocha, Yamen and planted it in Bababudan rage.
 
• Hence coffee was introduced in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Coffee plantations in Karnataka:

 
 
• The largest producer of coffee in India is Karnataka. 
 
• Karnataka accounts for 71% of India's coffee production.
 
• Kodagu is the largest coffee-producing district of Karnataka.
 
• It accounts for 33% of India's coffee production.
 
• Other major coffee-producing districts of Karnataka include Chikkamagaluru, Hassan, and Mysore.
 
• Arabica and Robusta are the varieties largely grown in Karnataka.
 
• The Coffee Board of India is headquartered in Chikkamagaluru, Karnataka.
